title: Functional defects of cancer-associated MDC1 mutations in DNA damage repair.
authors: Xie, Rong; Yan, Zhenzhen; Jing, Ju; Wang, Yukun; Zhang, Jiajia; Li, Yipeng; Liu, Xiuhua; Yu, Xiaochun; Wu, Chen
one_liner_zh: 该文研究癌症相关MDC1突变在DNA损伤修复中的功能缺陷，涉及蛋白-DNA互作（MDC1与gammaH2AX结合）及结构建模，但非TF-DNA体系，方法以实验为主、结构建模为辅，故评5分。
abstract: Mediator of DNA damage checkpoint protein 1 (MDC1) serves as a docking platform to promote the localization of various DNA damage response (DDR) components to DNA double-strand break (DSB) sites. MDC1 is vital in controlling proper DDR and maintaining genomic stability. In cancers, genomic instability results from mutations in DNA repair genes and drives cancer development. The mutations of MDC1 in human cancers have not been systematically examined and little is known about the molecular phenotypes caused by these genetic changes. Here, we summarized cancer-associated mutations of MDC1 including insertion/deletion mutations as well as missense mutations in key functional domains of MDC1 from ICGC, TCGA and COSMIC databases. We analyzed 711 somatic mutations of MDC1 across 26 types of human cancers and examined the functional defects of these cancer-associated mutations of MDC1 in the context of DNA damage repair. 6 truncation mutations and 7 missense mutations of MDC1 were chosen for further study. 6 truncation mutations which abolish MDC1-gammaH2AX interaction abrogate its biological functions in DNA damage repair. 2 missense mutations in FHA domain impaired ATM (ataxia telangiectasia mutated) phosphorylation. 5 missense mutations in BRCT domain also abolished its interaction with gammaH2AX, resulting in defects in foci formation of MDC1, 53BP1 and BRCA1 as well as defects in G2/M checkpoints. We further used structural modeling to analyze the potential molecular mechanism by which the 7 missense mutations cause the DNA damage repair defects. Taken together, our results reveal these cancer-associated MDC1 mutations can result in functional defects in DNA damage response and may serve as biomarkers for cancer diagnostics in future.
abstract_zh: DNA损伤检查点蛋白1（MDC1）作为对接平台，促进多种DNA损伤应答（DDR）组分定位至DNA双链断裂（DSB）位点。MDC1在调控正确的DDR及维持基因组稳定性中至关重要。在癌症中，基因组不稳定性源于DNA修复基因的突变，并驱动癌症发展。人类癌症中MDC1的突变尚未被系统研究，且这些遗传改变引起的分子表型知之甚少。在此，我们从ICGC、TCGA和COSMIC数据库中总结了MDC1的癌症相关突变，包括插入/缺失突变及MDC1关键功能域中的错义突变。我们分析了26种人类癌症中MDC1的711个体细胞突变，并检查了这些癌症相关MDC1突变在DNA损伤修复背景下的功能缺陷。选取了6个截短突变和7个错义突变进行进一步研究。6个截短突变消除了MDC1与gammaH2AX的相互作用，从而废除其在DNA损伤修复中的生物学功能。FHA结构域中的2个错义突变损害了ATM（共济失调毛细血管扩张突变）磷酸化。BRCT结构域中的5个错义突变也消除了其与gammaH2AX的相互作用，导致MDC1、53BP1和BRCA1的焦点形成缺陷以及G2/M检查点缺陷。我们进一步使用结构建模分析这7个错义突变导致DNA损伤修复缺陷的潜在分子机制。综上所述，我们的结果表明，这些癌症相关的MDC1突变可导致DNA损伤应答中的功能缺陷，并可能在未来作为癌症诊断的生物标志物。
